text:
tayla: Vendor update — 40 H100s bound for FRA hub are being held by customs due to missing RMA origin docs. They want a signed supplier RMA declaration + copy of repair certificate before release.

ben: Do we have EU spare pool capacity to cover this? What's the manifest?

tayla: Manifest is uploaded to secure drive. Vendor says shipment moved as 'RMA return' on paperwork but customs flagged because invoice lacks repair origin field.

zhang: Short-term impact: eu-edge capacity down ~10%. Canary for personalization tweak is tomorrow noon CET. Options: 1) accept split release if vendor can release partial, 2) crossdock loaners from our AMS spare cache, 3) temporary cloud Dedicated for critical traffic. Cost trade-offs noted.

rma-bot: New ticket RMA-2026-091 created and assigned to tayla + ben.

ben: Push vendor for split release — even 20 units would help. Also ask forwarder for pre-clear checklist.

tayla: Vendor proposes 22 units release, 18 held. They request we sign a provisional RMA accepting brokerage liability only. They attached a sample PDF.

finance: We can cover brokerage up to $30k for provisional RMA. Any amount beyond needs VP approval.

zhang: Routing plan: if p95 > 190ms for 3m, shift 25% of selected routes to dedicated-eu-fallback. Also prepare to borrow 6 GPUs from training-pool.

ben: Forwarder requests scanned signature + company letterhead + manifest CSV annotated with RMA reference to pre-clear. Adding that to the ticket.

tayla: Uploaded signed provisional RMA limited to brokerage cap and the annotated manifest to RMA-2026-091. Forwarder acknowledged receipt.

ops-bot: Note — moving GPUs between pools will cause short-lived KV cache warmup; expect 60-120s latency spike for affected routes.

ben: Crossdock window requested for 03/21 02:00-05:00 UTC for the 22 release. Can staging accept?

zhang: Staging confirmed. Alex from induction team will oversee labeling.

ben: Vendor just sent loaner AWB LOAN-FRA-7721. Forwarder says customs pre-clear pending our signed RMA — which is uploaded.

finance: Confirmed cost cap $30k for brokerage. Notify if vendor pushes extra fees.

ops-bot: Adding routing rule to infra: "if p95_latency_ms > 190 for 180s -> increase weight dedicated-eu-fallback by 25%, ttl=900s". Will PR for review.

ben: Forwarder called — customs asked for certificate of origin (COO). Vendor says COO attached but customs wants it on supplier letterhead. I've requested vendor reissue.

tayla: Vendor reissued COO on supplier letterhead and sent to forwarder. Forwarder says if paperwork OK, they'll release 22 units tonight.

rma-bot: Ticket update: vendor docs mapped; awaiting customs final ok.

zhang: Confirming we will move 6 GPUs from training-pool to edge-pool at induction to cover service delta. Also warm 8 dedicated nodes as standby.

ben: Crossdock inbound ETA 03:40 UTC. I'll monitor induction and post serial ranges.

ben: Induction complete at 03:55 UTC. 22 units ingested, serials added to inventory. Current eu-edge p95: 94ms.

tayla: Thank you all. Remaining 18 units still pending inspection; vendor committed to inspection within 48h and will ship replacements if DOA. Closing while we monitor RMA ticket. :white_check_mark:
